hypothesis: The measurements suggest exceptional initialization costs in two distinct short-prompt states, followed by relatively uniform admission costs. Explicit indicators isolate these exceptions while prompt sizes model steady-state variation.

pcvs.expression: len(prompt.prompt_token_ids or []) if isinstance(prompt, EngineCoreRequest) else len(prompt.get('prompt_token_ids', [])) if isinstance(prompt, dict) else 0
pcvs.name: prompt_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Models token-dependent admission work across the observed prompt sizes.

pcvs.expression: len(prompt_text or '') if isinstance(prompt, EngineCoreRequest) else len(prompt.get('prompt', '') or '') if isinstance(prompt, dict) else len(prompt) if isinstance(prompt, str) else 0
pcvs.name: prompt_characters
pcvs.rationale: Models text-dependent request and detokenizer setup.

pcvs.expression: int((len(prompt.prompt_token_ids or []) if isinstance(prompt, EngineCoreRequest) else len(prompt.get('prompt_token_ids', [])) if isinstance(prompt, dict) else 0) == 10)
pcvs.name: ten_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Separates the observed ten-token state with exceptionally high cost; this is a workload-specific proxy for initialization, not an assumed general token-length effect.

pcvs.expression: int((len(prompt.prompt_token_ids or []) if isinstance(prompt, EngineCoreRequest) else len(prompt.get('prompt_token_ids', [])) if isinstance(prompt, dict) else 0) == 9)
pcvs.name: nine_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Separates the other short-prompt state, whose cost exceeds the steady-state calls.
